newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable amid foreign fund inflow.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable amid foreign fund inflow.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against the U.S. dollar on Monday on some foreign fund inflows, offsetting a firming U.S. unit overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.495 against Saturday's T$27.493 close. Turnover through dealers was a slow US$121 million.
Foreign funds entered in the morning session, probably for the rallying domestic stock market, dealers said.

"Because of the fund inflows and the absence of the expected month-end U.S. dollar demand, the market did not react to the strong greenback overaseas," said a dealer. For Tuesday, a steady T$27.49-27.50 range was seen. -- James Peng (5080815)
